name: What should I expect during construction on a luxury remodel or rebuild?

mainEntity.name: What happens after construction starts on a high-end home project in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What happens after construction starts on a high-end home project in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once construction begins, the project usually moves through site prep or demolition, foundation and structural work, rough framing, mechanical and electrical work, inspections, waterproofing, interior finishes, and final closeout. Luxury projects often involve more coordination than standard builds because custom materials, specialty trades, and finish sequencing must happen in the correct order. Homeowners should expect regular updates on budget, schedule, selections, and field decisions. It is also common for the builder to manage multiple trades that depend on each other, so a small delay can ripple through the job if not handled quickly. The best experience comes from a builder who communicates clearly, documents decisions, and flags issues early. In luxury construction, progress is not just physical; it is also administrative and logistical.
acceptedAnswer.description: After construction starts, homeowners should expect demolition or site prep, structural work, rough utilities, inspections, waterproofing, finishes, and punch-list closeout. Luxury projects usually require frequent coordination because custom materials and specialty trades must arrive in the right sequence. Regular updates matter as much as the actual build activity.
